body.name: Known-cutoff inverted grid set and interval
body.construction: For a finite nonempty effect grid \(\mathcal G_\vartheta\subseteq\Theta\), define \[\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{kc}}=\{\vartheta\in\mathcal G_\vartheta:\Delta_n(c_P,\vartheta)\le\Gamma_n^{\mathrm{kc}}(\delta_n)\}.\] Let \(F_n^{\mathrm{kc}}\) be the union of the certified fallback branches listed in \(\text{def:worked-four-cell-grid}\), with cutoff profiling suppressed. Define the connected rule \[I_n^{\mathrm{kc}}=\begin{cases}\Theta,&F_n^{\mathrm{kc}}\text{ occurs},\\ \operatorname{hull}(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{kc}}),&(F_n^{\mathrm{kc}})^c\text{ occurs},\end{cases}\] with \(\operatorname{hull}(\varnothing)=\varnothing\). Thus only \(\Delta_n(c_P,\vartheta)\) is inverted, and every listed certified fallback returns \(\Theta\).
